there were no uniform clinical handling of patients with renal cell carcinoma in any of the countries.

we have a great deal to learn from our colleagues in the Nordic countries, especially in Denmark.
there are significant differences in the handling of renal cell carcinoma in different countries and even between departments in the same country.

there are differences in clinical practice in the Nordic countries, and that this must be taken into account when performing multicentre studies.
it is important that multicentre studies are performed with great care, and that the participating departments should be well acquainted with each other's routines and methods.
